Image

DWRA’s Water Quality Improvement Grant Program provides funding to Florida's governmental entities (cities, counties, municipalities, etc.) to address wastewater (including septic to sewer), stormwater and agricultural sources of nutrients in waterbodies that are not attaining nutrient or nutrient-related standards, have an established total maximum daily load or are located within a basin management action plan area, a reasonable assurance plan area, an accepted alternative restoration plan area, or a rural area of opportunity under s. 288.0656.

For future Water Quality Improvement Grant opportunity updates, sign up at the Protecting Florida Together Preference Center or subscribe to DEP's website for updates and announcements.

This below dashboard was created in accordance with subsection 403.0673(8), Florida Statutes, to allow users to explore project information associated with the Water Quality Improvement Grant program. The Department continues to work towards updating information on this dashboard, including water quality information, to further enhance the user’s experience. Please check back soon for updates! The Department further welcomes your comments and suggestions on this dashboard—please email .
